data_snapshot: data/FHA_Unified_Database.json (3,366 records as committed; 3,198 at the 2026-05-02 run this file documents, before the 2026-07-03 corpus refresh)

stage1_screening.label: FHA Relevance Screening
stage1_screening.produces: screening_result field on T0 (3,198 records at this run; T1 = 2,522 passed). The 2026-07-03 CourtListener refresh appended 168 further screened-in records, bringing the committed database to T0 = 3,366 / T1 = 2,690 (see article/appendices/Appendix_A_Case_Dataset_Methodology.md, sec. A.5)

stage2_triple_classification.label: Triple-Model Independent Classification (Layer 1 base classifiers)
stage2_triple_classification.input_truncation: Case texts >50,000 chars are truncated, preserving first 25,000 + last 25,000 characters.

abandoned_evaluations.label: GLM-5
abandoned_evaluations.status: Evaluated as a candidate base classifier but not used in Layer 1.
abandoned_evaluations.note: GLM-5.1 IS used as a base classifier in Layer 2 (mechanism-family ensemble) and as the escalation model in the supplementary classification script (scripts/unified_overnight_openrouter.py). It is not part of the Layer 1 primary classification pipeline that produced data/FHA_Unified_Database.json.

tier3_haiku.label: Anthropic Haiku 4.5 (non-critical-field 3-way splits)
tier3_haiku.task: Adjudicate three-way splits on non-critical categorical fields

tier4_sonnet.label: Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 (critical-field 3-way splits)
tier4_sonnet.task: Adjudicate three-way splits on outcome / primary_claim_type / claim_types and re-extract free-text narrative fields

stage5_reproducibility_audit.label: Reproducibility Audit (independent re-classification)
stage5_reproducibility_audit.stratification: stratified random sample across Tier 0-4 buckets from T1 (FHA-screened) corpus

layer2_mechanism_ensemble.label: Three-Model Majority-Vote Ensemble (mechanism-family classification on T4 pleading-loss universe)
layer2_mechanism_ensemble.scope: 676-case T4 universe; 668 cases produced parseable output from all three coders

layer3_kimi_k2_6_single_re_read.label: Kimi K2.6 stratified single-model re-read
layer3_kimi_k2_6_single_re_read.scope: 150-case stratified sample from T4 (representation status × original family bucket)

supplementary_classification_layer1_supp.label: Supplementary classification for H1/H2/H7 supplemental schema (NOT Layer 1 primary)
supplementary_classification_layer1_supp.purpose: Adds derived fields (pleading_failure_family, tier1_tier2_fixability, etc.) on top of the canonical Layer 1 classification

escalation_model.label: GLM-5.1
escalation_model.role: Escalation when primary returns low-confidence or unparseable output

supplementary_classification_layer1_supp.note: This is a downstream supplemental analysis, not the Layer 1 production pipeline that built data/FHA_Unified_Database.json.
